high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post by the verified account "oprah," which was posted 23 hours prior to the screenshot being taken. The individual is dressed in a stylish outfit consisting of a white button-up shirt layered over a sheer, ruffled top, paired with shiny, metallic gold pants. They are also wearing black ankle boots and holding a large, structured handbag in their right hand. The person has long, wavy hair and is wearing sunglasses.
